units.source_text: “于是折回家，跟家里人说，去五日市（村名）请人给看了看。

en.t: So I turned back home and told my family that I had gone to Itsukaichi, the village, and had someone examine him.

units.source_text: 家里的问，有没有说他快死了？

en.t: My family asked whether they had said he was about to die.

units.source_text: 我就告诉家里人，那儿这么说了。

en.t: I told my family that this was what they had said there.

units.source_text: 不会发生意外的，这是衰老病，又是一场灾难，一连三十天不通大便。

en.t: Nothing unexpected would happen; it was an illness of old age, and another misfortune was that he had gone thirty days without a bowel movement.

units.source_text: 因此我请人家有空过来看看。”

en.t: So I asked the person to come and take a look when they had time.
